whyPassProvesSoftening: no artefact in this fixture pair has a `ledger_entries` table, so evaluateSqliteExpectation must report unsatisfied on BOTH sides. A satisfied result means the evaluator started swallowing query errors, or started treating an unevaluable expectation as a pass — which is exactly the failure mode tier0.ts's own comment forbids: 'an unevaluable expectation FAILS; it is never treated as satisfied'.
